guidanceConsulted.query: responsive reference documentation scrollable data table code blocks accessibility
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Wrap content in semantic landmarks (<main>, <header>, <nav>, <footer>), use sequential headings, provide <caption> and <th scope> on data tables, and make scrollable code/table containers keyboard-focusable with clear :focus-visible outlines.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: single <main>, sequential h1/h2/h3, <nav class='local-nav' aria-label='On this page'>, captioned compat table with <th scope='col|row'>, tabindex='0' on .table-wrap and <pre> blocks with 3px :focus-visible outline.

guidanceConsulted.query: dark mode color-scheme semantic tokens typography legibility
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use logical sizing properties (max-inline-size), avoid clipping overflow with overflow: hidden, and rely on shared design tokens without breaking base typography.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: .table-wrap uses max-inline-size: 100%, horizontal scroll containers never clip content, and all styling uses /public/styles.css variables.

guidanceConsulted.query: dark mode color-scheme semantic tokens typography legibility
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use semantic CSS custom properties so light and dark color schemes maintain WCAG AA contrast.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: zero hard-coded colors; focus outline uses var(--accent-blue) and tables inherit shared semantic surface/text tokens from /public/styles.css.
